method: Every all_items entry of the v9.5.1 feed. Default gold: PRIMARY_MATCH -> its repd_ref, DISCOVERY_ONLY -> none. Overrides (label_source 'override') are N3's reading of the headline against the October 2026 REPD register; 'unsure' rows (ambiguous referent) and 'implicit' rows (referent known from context but the headline names no project) are excluded from metrics. Labels are silver: one reader, headline text only, no article bodies. Gold refs are October 2026 REPD Ref IDs.
